concepts.query: harness 하네스 에이전트 스캐폴딩 구조가 에이전트를 제약
concepts.web: A harness is the external scaffolding around an LLM that turns it into a working agent: the loop, tool calls, context management, memory, guardrails, tracing. LLM compliance is probabilistic not deterministic, combined with deterministic outer-harness constraints like linters and CI gates. Agent performance governed by the interaction between model and runtime, not model capability alone. Instruction layer, tool layer, environment layer. Failures trace to context drift, schema misalignment, state degradation.
concepts.kg: Living Harness. LLM alone talented but unreliable; LLM + Harness creates a reliable system; trust emerges from structural constraints not instruction. Four pillars: Inform via context engineering, Constrain solution space via Span and Contract, Verify through automated testing, Correct. Code structure itself constrains agent behavior; when an agent fails improve the harness structure not the agent.

concepts.web: RAG systems fetch relevant information for generation. Sparse retrieval BM25 keyword matching high interpretability but lacks semantic nuance. Dense retrieval semantic embeddings BERT SentenceTransformers capture contextual relationships but miss precise terms and proper nouns. Hybrid retriever combines BM25 with dense to balance precision and recall, candidate chunks merged into an enriched pool. Reranking cross-encoder refines results, higher precision at top ranks, fewer hallucinations, better faithfulness.

concepts.web: LLM multi-agent orchestration coordinates multiple agents for complex tasks. Robust orchestration protocols cover role assignment, communication, collaboration, context sharing. A centralized puppeteer orchestrator dynamically activates agents with reinforcement learning policy. AutoGen CAMEL MetaGPT emphasize role specialization and interaction protocols. Shared persistent state carries context between agent steps and across agent boundaries. Context windows have hard limits so a single agent loses coherence.

concepts.query: 컨텍스트 엔지니어링 KV 캐시 프롬프트 캐싱 재사용
concepts.web: The KV cache stores attention keys and values for every token to reuse them in future steps instead of recalculating. Prefill phase processes the prompt and generates KV tensors, decode phase autoregressively generates output. Reduces attention time from O(n squared) to O(n). Prefix caching for common prefixes, semantic caching retrieves reusable KV states via cosine similarity between prompts. KV cache size grows linearly with sequence length and exhausts GPU memory in long-context scenarios.
concepts.kg: StreamingLLM sliding window recent token KVs plus attention sink stable streaming. All heads share single K/V, KV cache h-fold reduction, inference speed up quality small drop. K/V compressed to low-rank latent vector, KV cache 10x reduction, RoPE separated key, DeepSeek-V2 V3. Key-value cache storage holds attention states consuming VRAM proportional to context length.

concepts.web: CodeAgent is an LLM framework leveraging external tools for repo-level code generation, using bootstrap functions and classes across multiple files. Autonomous coding agents use an LLM as central engine with a memory module, planning component, and tool utilization module. File operation tools read files and terminal tools execute system commands. A bootstrappable specification for a file-search agent returns ranked file paths. Claude Code, Cline, Devin autonomous software engineer plans codes debugs deploys.
concepts.kg: Coding Agent Method Selection Policy. Coding Agent Methodology Priority. Real GitHub issues and pull requests for evaluating AI coding agents. Anthropic CLI coding agent for multi-file analysis and code generation. OpenAI coding agent product spanning CLI IDE app and cloud web surfaces.

concepts.query: 에이전트 평가 방법론 통계적 유의성 판정
concepts.web: LLM-as-judge uses a language model to score outputs against a rubric for open-ended outputs. 100 to 500 test cases per category give statistically meaningful results, fewer than 50 make it hard to draw confident conclusions. Sample size depends on baseline, minimum detectable effect, statistical power, and significance level. Judge bias: models prefer outputs matching their own style, mitigated with multiple judge models, calibration against human ratings, explicit rubric. Expert-domain judge agreement drops to 64 to 68 percent.
